Amharic: ኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ግን፣ ጥቂት የሆስፒታል ግምገማዎች አሉ።

Source: In this study, the researchers wanted to evaluate how a referral hospital in southern Sidama province in Sidamo district, Ethiopia, was used by surrounding patients.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baagala okwekenneenya engeri amalwaliro mu bbendobendo ery’obukiikaddyo mu disitulikiti ya Sidama, ethioppia, kwakozesebwa abalwadde abeetooloddewo.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn olùwádìí fẹ́ ṣẹ ìgbéléwọ̀n bí àwọn aláìsàn káàkiri agbègbè àwọn ilé ìwòsàn ní agbègbè southern Sidama ní ẹkùn Sidamo, Ethiopia ṣe máa ń ṣe àmúlò ìtọ́kasí wọn.
Zulu: Kulolu ncwaningo abancwaningi babehlose ukuthola ukuthi isibhedlela ekudluliselwa kuso iziguli zaseNingizimi yesifundazwe sase -Sidamu esifundeni se-Sidamo e-Ethopia, sisetshenzizwa iziguli zezindawo ezisondelene naso.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su tantance yadda al’ummar yanki da suke kusa da suke amfani da wani asibitin turowa a kudancin lardin Sidama a gundumar Sidamo ta Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go sekaseka ka fao sepetlele seo ba romelago balwetši go sona ka borwa bja phrobentshe ya Sidama ka seleteng sa Sidamo, Ethiopia, se ilego sa šomišwa ke balwetši ba tikologo.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ በኢትዮጵያ፣ በሲዳሞ ወረዳ፣ በሲዳሞ አውራጃ የሚገኘው ሪፈራል ሆስፒታል በአካባቢው ህሙማን እንዴት ጥቅም ላይ እንደዋለ ለመገምገም ፈለጉ።

Source: They used available data from the mid 1980s.
Luganda: Baakozesa obubaka obwaliwo okuva mu myaka gya 1980 egyawakati.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àmúlò àwọn dátà tí ó wà nílẹ̀ láti àárín 1980.
Zulu: Basebenzise ulwazi olugciniwe lwaphakathi kweminyaka yango-1980.
Hausa: Sun yi amfani da bayanan da aka samu daga tsakiyar shekarun 1980.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba šomiša tshedimošo ye e hwetšagalago go tšwa lebakanakong la magareng ga bo 1980.
Amharic: ከ1980ዎቹ አጋማሽ ጀምሮ ያለውን ውሂብ ተጠቅመዋል።

Source: The area that a hospital serves is known as its catchment area - in this case, the Sidamo district.
Luganda: Ekitundu ekiweererezebwamu eddwaliro kiyitibwa ekitundu ekyetooloddewo – mu ngeri eno kye kitundu kya disitulikiti yaSidama.
Yoruba: Agbègbè tí ó ń lo ilé ìwòsàn ni a mọ̀ sí agbègbè àkànmọ́ – ẹkùn Sidamo ni pàtó.
Zulu: Indawo ebhekelelwe kakhulu isibhedlela, ngokomcwaningo ibizwa ngesizinda sosizo lokwelashwa, isifunda sase-Sidamo sichazwe njengohlobo lendawo enjalo .
Hausa: Yankin da asibiti yake yi wa hidima ana kiransa da wurin turowa - a wannan yanayin, gundumar Sidamo.
Northern Sotho: Lefelo leo le abelwago ke sepetlele ditirelo le tsebja bjalo ka lefelo la go fana ka balwetši – gomme mo lebakeng le ke selete sa Sidamo.
Amharic: ሆስፒታሉ የሚያገለግልበት ቦታ ተፋሰስ ተብሎ ይታወቃል - በዚህ ሁኔታ የሲዳሞ ወረዳ።

Source: A referral hospital often offers more services than other facilities in its catchment area, and thus gets patients referred to it for such services.
Luganda: Eddwaliro erisingako litera okubeera n’obuweereza okusinga ku ago agali mu bitundu ebyetooloddewo, bwe lityo ne lifuna abalwade abasindikibwayo olw’obuweereza obwo.
Yoruba: Ilé ìwòsàn ìtókasí ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà máa ń kó ipa tí ó pọ̀ ju àwọn ilé ìwòsàn yókù ní agègbè àkànmọ́ rẹ̀, fún ìdí èyí, wọ́n máa ń ní àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́ dárí sí wọn fún ìdí onírúurú.
Zulu: Isibhedlela okudluleselwa kuso iziguli sivame ukuba nezinsiza zokwelapha ezanele ngaphezu kwezibhedlela ezikhale endaweni eyisizinda sosizo lokwelashwa .Ngaleso sizathu iziguli eziningi zigcina zidluliselwe kuso.
Hausa: Asibitin na turowa sau da yawa yana bayar da ƙarin ayyuka fiye da sauran wuraren da ake turowai, kuma ta haka ne ake turo marasa lafiya don irin waɗannan ayyukan.
Northern Sotho: Sepetlele seo balwetši ba romelwago go sona gantši se fana ka ditirelo tše ntyši go feta mafelo a mangwe a tša maphelo lefeleong la sona la go fana ka balwetši, gomme ka go realo se hwetša balwetši bao ba rometšwego go sona go hwetša ditirelo tšeo.
Amharic: ሪፈራል ሆስፒታሉ ብዙውን ጊዜ በተፋሰሱ አካባቢ ካሉ ሌሎች ተቋማቶች የበለጠ አገልግሎት ይሰጣል፣ እና ስለዚህ ለእንደዚህ አይነት አገልግሎቶች ታካሚዎችን ወደ እሱ እንዲላክ ያደርጋል።

Source: Here, the researchers reviewed the hospital’s admission records for the years 1985 and 1986.
Luganda: Wano, abanoonyereza beekaliriza ebiwandiiko by’abalwadde abaweebwa ebitanda mu myaka gya 1985 ne 1986.
Yoruba: Níbí, àwọn olùwádìí ṣe àtúngbéyẹ̀wò àkọ́sílẹ̀ ilé ìwòsàn yìí fún àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n gbà láàárín ọdún 1985 àti 1986.
Zulu: Kuloluncwaningo abancwaningi babuyekeze amarekhodi enani leziguli ezangeniswa esibhedlela ngonyaka ka-1985 kuya ku-1986.
Hausa: A nan, masu binciken sun sake duba bayanan kwantarwa a asibitin na shekarun 1985 da 1986.
Northern Sotho: Mo, banyakišiši ba lekodišišitše dipego tša go amogelwa sepetlele tša mengwaga ya 1985 le 1986.
Amharic: እዚህ፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ የ1985 እና 1986 ዓመታት የሆስፒታሉን የመግቢያ መዝገቦችን ገምግመዋል።

Source: For each patient, they recorded age, sex, where they lived, where they were referred from, which ward they were admitted to, their diagnosis and whether or not they died during their hospital stay.
Luganda: Ku buli mulwadde, baawandiika emyaka, ekikula, gye baabeera, gye baavudde okusindikibwa mu ddwaliro eryo, waadi gye baabasindiseemu, okukeberebwa kwe baafunye ne oba nga baafiira mu ddwaliro mu kiseera we baabeereramu.
Yoruba: Fún aláìsàn kọ̀ọ̀kan, wọ́n ṣe àgbàsílẹ̀ ọjọ́ orí, ìjẹ́ akọ́-n-bábò, ibi tí wọ́n ń gbé, ibí tí wọ́n ti tọ́ka wọn sí ilé ìwòsàn yìí ní pàtó, wọ́ọ̀dù tí wọ́n gbà wọ́n wọlé sí, irú àìsàn tí wọ́n ṣe wádìí pé ó ń ṣe wọ́n, àti bóyá wọ́n kú sí ilé ìwòsàn náà ní àkókò tí wọ́n wà níbẹ̀.
Zulu: Esigulini ngasinye bathatha imininingwano: yeminyaka, yobulili, yendawo esihlala kuyo, igama lesibhedlela abebedluliswe kuso, igama lewodi ababengeniswe kuyo, umhlahlo wezsifo kanye neminingwane yokuthi zangcina zishonile yini ngesikhathi ezazisihlale esibhedlela.
Hausa: Ga kowane majiyyaci, sun rubuta shekaru da jinsi da inda suke zaune da inda aka turo su, wace ɗaki aka kwantar da su da gano cuta da ko sun mutu a lokacin da suke asibitin ko a’a.
Northern Sotho: Go molwetši yo mongwe le yo mongwe, ba ngwadile mengwaga, bong, fao ba bego ba dulago gona, fao ba bego ba rometšwe go tšwa gona, ba be ba amogetšwe ka wateng efe, phekolo ya bona ya bolwetši le ge eba ba ile ba hlokofala ge ba be ba le ka sepetlele goba aowa.
Amharic: ለእያንዳንዱ ታካሚ፣ ዕድሜን፣ ጾታን፣ የት እንደሚኖር፣ ከየት እንደተላከ፣ በየትኛው ክፍል እንደተቀበሉ፣ የምርመራ ውጤታቸው እና በሆስፒታል ቆይታቸው መሞታቸውን ወይም አለመሞታቸውን መዝግበዋል።

Source: The researchers observed that 85% of admitted patients were from the Sidamo district, and only 15% from other districts.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza beetegereza nti ebitundu 85% eby’abalwadde abaaweebwanga ebitanda baavanga mu disitulikiti ya Sidamo ate ebitundu 15% mu disitulikiti endala.
Yoruba: Olùwádìí ṣe àkíyèsí pé ìdá 85% àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n gbà ni wọ́n wá láti ẹkùn Sidamo, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ìdá 15% láti ẹkùn mìíràn.
Zulu: Abancwaningi bathola ukuthi iziguli ezingama-85% ezazingeniswe esibhedlela kwakungezasesifundeni sase-Sidamo ebese kuthi ezyidlanmzana elingama-15% zazivele ezifundeni zangaphandle.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun lura cewa kashi 85% na majiyyatan da aka kwantar sun fito ne daga gundumar Sidamo, kuma kashi 15% kawai ne daga sauran gundumomi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemogile gore 85% ya balwetši bao ba amogetšwego ba be ba etšwa seleteng sa Sidamo, gomme ke fela 15% go tšwa ka dileteng tše dingwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደተመለከቱት 85% ታማሚዎች ከሲዳሞ ወረዳ የመጡ ሲሆኑ፣ ከሌሎች ወረዳዎች ደግሞ 15% ብቻ ናቸው።

Source: Of all those from Sidamo district, 67% lived in the local Sidama Province.
Luganda: Ku balwadde bonna abaavanga mu Sidamo, ebitundu 67% baabeeranga mu bbendobendo lya Sidamo lyennyini.
Yoruba: Ninú gbogbo àwọn tí wọ́n wá láti agbègbè Sidamo, ìdá 67% ní ó ń gbé ní ẹkùn Sidama.
Zulu: Iziguli ezazibalelwa kuma-67% zasesifundeni sase-Sidamo kwatholakla ukuthi zonke zaziyizakhamuzi zasesifundazweni sase-Sidama.
Hausa: Daga cikin waɗanda suka fito daga gundumar Sidamo, kashi 67% suna zaune ne a lardin Sidama.
Northern Sotho: Ka moka go bao ba tšwago ka seleteng sa Sidamo, 67% ba be ba dula ka Phrobentsheng ya kgauswi ya Sidama.
Amharic: ከሲዳሞ ወረዳ ተወላጆች፣ 67% ያህሉ በሲዳማ ጠቅላይ ግዛት ይኖሩ ነበር።

Source: The researchers said most referrals from outside the province were men whereas the local Sidama Province admitted more women than other provinces.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti abantu abasinga baaweerezebwanga mu malwaliro agasingako okuva ebweru w’ebbendobendo baalinga basajja so ng’ate ebbendobendo lya Sidama lyawanga abakyal ebitanda bangi okusinga amabendobendo amalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn tí wọ́n gba ìtọ́kasí wá sí ilé ìwòsàn yíì láti ẹkùn mìíràn, jẹ́ ọkùnrin, nígbà tí ẹkùn ìbílẹ̀ Sidama gba obìnrin púpọ̀ ju àwọn ẹkùn ìyókù lọ.
Zulu: Abancwaningi bathi iningi leziguli ezazidluliswe izifundazweni zangaphandlekwakungezesilisa kanti ezazingeniswe isifundazwe sase-Sidam iningi lazo kwakungabantu besifazane bendawo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce akasarin waɗanda aka turo daga wajen lardin maza ne yayin da lardin Sidama na cikin gida ya karɓi mata fiye da sauran larduna.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore bontši bja bao ba rometšwego sepetlele go tšwa ka ntle ga phrobentshe e be e le banna mola e le gore Phrobentshe ya kgauswi ya Sidama yona e amogetše basadi go feta ka diphrobentsheng tše dingwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከክፍለ ሀገሩ ውጪ ያሉት ሪፈራሎች አብዛኛዎቹ ወንዶች ሲሆኑ በሌላ በኩል የአካባቢው የሲዳማ ጠቅላይ ግዛት ከሌሎች ግዛቶች የበለጠ ሴቶችን ተቀብሏል ብለዋል።

Source: The surgical ward had more referrals than other wards and the children’s ward had the least referrals.
Luganda: Waadi erongoosebwamu yafunanga abalwadde baweerezebwayo bangi okusinga waadi endala ate waadi y’abaana ye yasinganga okusindikibwamu abantu abatono.
Yoruba: Àwọn Wọ́òdù tí wọ́n ti ń ṣe iṣẹ́ abẹ máa ń gba ìtọ́kasí jù àwọn wọ́ọ̀dù mìíràn ló, bẹ́ẹ̀ sì ní wọ́ọ̀dù àwọn ọmọdé kò ní ìtọ́kasí púpọ̀ rárá.
Zulu: Iningi leziguli ezazidlulisiwe zazigcwele ewodini lokuhlinza, umakuqhaniswa namanye amawodi, kanti amawodi abantwana wona eyenedlanzana leziguli ezazidlulisiwe.
Hausa: Sashen fiɗa ya fi yawan waɗanda ake turowa fiye sauran ɗakuna kuma sashin yara yana da mafi ƙanƙantar waɗanda ake turowa.
Northern Sotho: Wate ya karo e bile le balwetši ba bantši bao ba bego ba rometšwe go yona go feta diwate tše dingwe gomme wate ya bana yona e bile le balwetši ba mmalwanyana bao ba rometšwego go yona.
Amharic: የቀዶ ጥገናው ክፍል ከሌሎቹ ክፍሎች የበለጠ ሪፈራሎች ነበረው እና የልጆች ክፍል አነስተኛ ሪፈራሎች ነበሩት።

Source: The referred patients were mostly those with injuries.
Luganda: Abalwadde abaasinganga okuweerezebwayo beebo abaabanga n’ebiwundu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aláìsàn tí ó ní ìpalára ni àwọn tí wọ́n gba ìtọ́kasí jùlọ.
Zulu: Iningi leziguli ezazidlulisiwe kwakuyilezo ezazilimele.
Hausa: Majiyyatan da aka turo galibi waɗanda suka samu raunuka ne.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši bao ba bego ba rometšwe bontši bja bona ba be ba gobetše.
Amharic: ሪፈር የተባሉት ታካሚዎች በአብዛኛው ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ናቸው።

Source: The researchers also said 38.3% of the referrals were from small health posts 27.2% were from clinics and 34.2% from other hospitals.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baagamba nti ebitundu 38.3% eby’abalwadde baaweerezebwangayo baavanga mu bulwaliro obutono, ebitundu 27.2% baavanga mu kkirinika ate ebitundu 34.2% mu malwaliro amalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí tún sọ wípé ìdá 38.3% àwọn tí wọ́n gba ìtọ́kasí jẹ́ àwọ́n tí wọ́n wá láti àwọn ilé ìwòsàn kékèké nígbàtí ìdá 27.2% jẹ́ àwọn tí wọ́n wá láti àwọn ilé ìwòsàn tí kò tóbi púpọ̀, bẹ́ẹ̀ sì ní ìdá 34.2% ni àwọn tí wọ́n wá láti àwọn ilé ìwòsàn míìràn.
Zulu: Abancwaningi baqhuba ngokuthi iziguli ezazidlulisiwe ezingama-38.3% zazevela ezindaweni zomtholampilo ezincane, ezingama-27.2% zazisuka emtholampilo ebese kuthi ezingama 34.2% zazidluliswe ezibhedlela.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma ce kashi 38.3% na waɗanda aka turo sun fito ne daga ƙananan wuraren kiwon lafiya kashi 27.2% daga asibitocin da kuma kashi 34.2% daga wasu asibitoci.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši gape ba boletše gore 38.3% ya bao ba rometšwego ba be ba etšwa mafelong a mannyane a tša maophelo gomme 27.2% e be e etšwa dikliniking mola 34.2% e etšwa dipetleleng tše dingwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጨማሪም 38.3% ሪፈራሎች ከትንንሽ ጤና ኬላዎች 27.2% ከክሊኒኮች እና 34.2% ከሌሎች ሆስፒታሎች የተገኙ ናቸው ብለዋል።

Source: Their results also showed that referred patients stayed longer in the hospital and were more likely to die than other patients.
Luganda: Ebyavaamu byabwe era byalaga nti abalwadde abaaweerezebwanga baamalanga ebbanga ddene mu ddwaliro era baalabikanga nga bayinza okufa okusinga abalwadde abalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsì wọ̀n tún fi hàn pé àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n gba ìtọ́kasí wá máa ń pẹ́ ní ilé ìwòsàn, bẹ́ẹ̀ sì tún ni ó ṣe é ṣe kí wọ́n kú ju àwọn aláìsàn yókù lọ.
Zulu: Imiphumela yoncwaningo yaveza ukuthi iziguli ezazidlulisiwe zazihlala isikhathi eside esibhedlela, kanti futhi zazishona kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye iziguli.
